name: Microfiber Mini Car Duster
subtitle: Washable handheld duster for everyday cleaning
description: Handheld microfiber mini duster with a plastic handle for cleaning dust from car interiors, exteriors, home surfaces and kitchen areas. Its soft microfiber bristles are designed to lift and trap dust, while the compact washable design supports repeated everyday cleaning use.
story: This compact duster is suited to quick cleaning tasks where a larger cleaning tool feels unnecessary. The microfiber head can be used across car surfaces, shelves, appliances and other household areas, while the handled design provides a simple grip during use. After cleaning, the duster can be washed and air dried for reuse. Its small size also makes it easier to store in a car, cleaning cupboard or kitchen utility area when not in use.
shipping: Estimated delivery in around 7 days. Delivery may arrive earlier or take longer depending on your destination and carrier.
